extracted.intended_audience: artists and writers seeking residencies; donors, sponsors, and supporters of Yaddo
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page for Yaddo's artist residency program, describing who Yaddo serves, the benefits of residency, ways to support the organization, and links to application resources. Not a full application guideline — it links to separate 'Application Guidelines and Instructions' and FAQ pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Residency benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Residencies include room, board, a studio and more, granting you the opportunity to work without interruption in a supportive environment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly lists the core material/support benefits provided to residents (room, board, studio); frames the residency as providing 'time, space, and the freedom to create' so artists can work without interruption.

rubrics_metrics.name: Artist community scope / inclusivity
rubrics_metrics.description: Yaddo is the leading nonprofit retreat for artists and writers, who come from all nations and backgrounds to live and work in our supportive community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: States that applicants are drawn from 'all nations and backgrounds' and emphasizes a 'supportive community' as part of the program's character (suggests inclusivity and international scope).

rubrics_metrics.name: Application resources (links)
rubrics_metrics.description: Links present: 'About Applying', 'Application Guidelines and Instructions', 'FAQ', and 'Apply Now'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page points applicants to separate application guideline and instruction pages but does not include the detailed application criteria or selection rubric on this landing page; applicants must follow those linked resources for application requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational status and fundraising reliance
rubrics_metrics.description: Yaddo is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit. We rely upon donations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals nonprofit status and dependency on donor support; the page enumerates ways to support (Donate, Events, Volunteer, Partnership, Sponsored Residencies, Podcast Sponsorship) which is relevant to prospective funders/sponsors rather than applicant evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ways to support / engagement activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Events, volunteer, buy tickets, sponsor our fundraising events, galas & auctions; Partnership and Sponsored Residencies; specific benefit events listed (Chef Dinner, Golf Invitational, Summer Benefit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists concrete engagement and fundraising activities (dates/venues for upcoming benefit events) that stakeholders can participate in or sponsor; useful as guidance for donors and partners about support opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program impact and prestige
rubrics_metrics.description: Collectively, Yaddo artists have won 90 Pulitzer Prizes, 36 MacArthur Fellowships, 73 National Book Awards, 75 Emmy honors, 48 Grammy Awards, 14 Oscars, 19 Tony Awards, and a Nobel Prize in Literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides metrics of alumni achievement used to demonstrate program impact, prestige, and potential benefit to resident artists; functions as evidence of the residency's outcomes rather than as an application criterion on this page.
